Algebra 2 · Unit 1: Equations and Inequalities

Rational Equations

Solve equations with variable denominators by clearing fractions.

What you’ll learn

  • Solve by multiplying by the least common denominator
  • Find excluded values and extraneous solutions
  • Solve work-rate problems

The mountain biking connection

Two riders building a trail together: combined work rates lead to rational equations.

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 2: Solving Equations and Modeling Constraints

Race-Day Workshop

Join an enduro team’s technical crew: check suspension sag with formulas and absolute value, work out the speed a stage needs with rational equations, and survey a climb with a radical equation, then pass the Race-Day Certification.

Level
Intermediate to Advanced
Time
20-25 min
  • 3 missions
  • Sag calculator and tolerance gauge
  • Race clock simulator
  • Trail survey simulator
  • Algebra debugger
  • Race-Day Certification (6)
  • Optional complex-number extension

Practises here: Solve by multiplying by the least common denominator; Find excluded values and extraneous solutions

Launch lab → Race-Day Workshop

Interactive lab · from Algebra 2: Graphing Rational Functions

Enduro Route Intelligence Lab

Model enduro stage times with rational functions: domain, asymptotes and holes, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing rational expressions, and solving for a target time. Then survey trail distances and wheel geometry with radical functions, transformations, rational exponents and extraneous solutions.

Level
Intermediate to Advanced
Time
25-30 min
  • 4 missions
  • Race clock and asymptote explorer
  • Split-time simulator and rational workbench
  • Trail survey and radical equation solver
  • Wheel explorer and radical profile studio
  • Final Route Analysis (12)
  • Optional route data diagnostic

Practises here: Find excluded values and extraneous solutions; Solve by multiplying by the least common denominator
